manual_fixes: District palettes were selected editorially from local or regional character references; these colors are not a surveyed facade inventory.
Added six coastal and riverfront communities to complement the existing six Treasure Coast cities. Source bounds include real downtowns, lagoon crossings and barrier-island context.
Palm City has no town-label node in the snapshot. Used the real Old Palm City place node (154183414) as its explicitly identified riverfront representative anchor.

Applied the existing low residential porch recipe to untagged small residential footprints, preserving the approved 1–2 story house default; explicit commercial, hotel and apartment tags retain their own height handling.
The Manatee Pocket open-water sea/river seam was replaced by the actual mapped tidal river banks for shoreline validation; the OSM land mask was preserved. See shoreline-resolution.json.
Added nested Town package lookup support to the existing boat exporter; vessel placement rules are unchanged.
Hero cameras are curated to mapped waterfronts, downtown streets, parks or marinas; see town-hero-sources.json.
